scientific_question: Do observational day/night straight-line GPS displacement q and q~astronomical daylength associations change when the SAME original source tagged animal-day sequence is reduced from 1h to 2h GPS duty-cycle, and does such thinning reduce the estimable animal population?
study_roster: Original Utah DOI 10.5441/001/1.711 four native taxa, Wyoming DOI 10.5441/001/1.703 two taxa, plus six pre-event-registered new source studies including one great egret over-200MB source metadata HOLD. All 8 original DOIs and 12 study×taxon records preserved. No replacements.

sampling.original_baseline: Use exact previously frozen public source file UUID/size/MD5 and original preexisting timestamp-selected closest-to-hour GPS fixes. Replay original full-hour source q and within individual-year q~daylength effect means and animal support counts to <1e-12 before alternate subsetting.
sampling.baseline_interval_hours: 0.5 to 2.0, original solar-period at segment start/midpoint/end, <=60 km/h

deterministic_reduced_cadence.selector: original source hourly time bin UTC hour parity ==0
original source hourly time bin UTC hour parity ==1

sampling.thinned_interval_hours: 1.5 <= observed between-fixed-fix elapsed hours <= 2.5; same astronomical day/part at GPS endpoints and midpoint; GPS speed <=60km/h; no interpolation of missing fixes or solar period.
sampling.day_level_proxy: Minimum straight-line displacement velocity km/h from successive qualified GPS fix locations. q_day = log1p(median admitted nighttime speed) - log1p(median admitted daytime speed). Retain only dates with >=3 DAY and >=3 NIGHT admitted steps for each observed cadence.
sampling.same_support_rule: For each original tagged animal and calendar year, intersect day-qualified records from baseline and current parity; >=10 matched original local solar dates. Average q separately across same dates then per-animal equal over qualified years. Daylength slope requires >=10 matched dates and source modeled daylight range >=0.5 h. Never call an unmatched animal/day a zero.
sampling.inferential_units: Original source study DOI independent study count; native taxa within a study dependent. Source-tagged animal is paired resampling unit, 2000 fixed seed animal bootstrap draws for delta parity-minus-hourly on matched dates. No independent GPS fix-level P-values.
sampling.q_delta_definition: mean within original tagged animal q at 2h observed cadence minus baseline 1h q computed on exactly the matched date set, not a change in biology over time.
sampling.daylength_delta_definition: within animal/year OLS q~daylength each cadence evaluated over the same qualified matched date set, then per animal equal across years. Require >=5 matched animals for descriptive source level delta and 95% percentile.
sampling.source_retention: Retain all 12 study×taxon cohort rows including source metadata HOLD, inadequate temporal cadence, no paired tags, and signs with zero-spanning uncertainty. Report 1h original admissible tags, matched tags, matched animal-years/day count and phase attrition. Do not drop negative/null outcomes or replace sources.
sampling.no_joint_weather_claim: No ERA5 request is made. This is an observation-process sensitivity of movement speed vs sampling interval; independent of old provider raw SHA version holds and negative 48-study radiation direction replication.

safety.raw_GPS_files: ephemeral GitHub runner only; verify original source checksums, no animal tag ID, original event timestamp, geographical coordinates, grid keys, per-animal estimates or raw tracks published.
safety.science_ceiling: Within tagged original animals, q at 1h and 2h is not the same biological estimand: sampled straight-line displacement decreases across longer GPS spans due to tortuous paths and solar-daypart boundary selection. A change due to thinning is a measurement/protocol effect, NOT evidence that animals changed behavior.
